# Yuhan (Hailey) Liu

I am a PhD candidate in Applied Economics at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics and a jointly supervised PhD researcher in Civil and Urban Engineering at New York University Abu Dhabi.

My research sits at the intersection of urban and transport economics, environmental and energy economics, empirical industrial organization, and public policy evaluation. I study how regulation, infrastructure, market competition, and fiscal and non-fiscal incentives shape technology adoption, consumer behavior, social welfare, and distributional outcomes.

## Research interests

::: {.interest-grid}
::: {.interest-card}
### Urban and transport economics

Travel demand, sustainable mobility, transport regulation, pricing, access constraints, and infrastructure policy.
:::

::: {.interest-card}
### Environmental and energy economics

Electric-vehicle adoption, energy efficiency, environmental externalities, and policy design.
:::

::: {.interest-card}
### Empirical industrial organization

Structural demand estimation, discrete choice models, market competition, and counterfactual simulation.
:::

::: {.interest-card}
### Public policy evaluation

Causal inference, welfare and distributional analysis, and evidence for government decision-making.
:::
:::
